name: Wakayama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with a navy star-shaped mark of radiating kana.
history: The flag of Wakayama bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Wakayama municipal emblem — a navy star-shaped mark of radiating kana
features.symbolism: the kana ワ (wa) radiating like a compass
